evidence.ACL: Intact anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: oblique tear of the body and posterior horn
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Intrasubstance degeneration of the lateral meniscus, without tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Thinning of the medial femoral cartilage without full-thickness defect.
evidence.Lateral OA: Preserved lateral femorotibial cartilage thickness without full-thickness defect.
evidence.PF OA: Cartilage fissuring of the lateral patellar facet, without full-thickness defect.
evidence.Baker's: Large popliteal cyst measuring 6.5 x 3.8 x 1.6 cm, with distal leakage suggesting rupture.
evidence.Contusion: Subchondral fracture of the medial femoral condyle without impaction and associated bone marrow edema.
evidence.Fracture: Subchondral fracture of the medial femoral condyle without impaction
